item.title: Elon Musk's "X" Files Lawsuit to Invalidate California's Content Moderation Legislation - Redorbit
item.description: X has filed a lawsuit to stop enforcement of California’s new state-level content moderation law, Assembly Bill 587. It alleges that the measure could have a chilling effect on rights outlined in the First Amendment to the Constitution, especially free speech laws. item.title: Telesat Selects SpaceX to Launch Broadband Satellites - Redorbit
item.description: Canadian broadband communications company Telesat tapped SpaceX to launch its “Lightspeed” satellite constellation. The first satellites will launch in 2026 and the full constellation will be in orbit by late 2027 if everything goes as planned. item.title: SpaceX Lands Pentagon Contract for Starshield - Redorbit
item.description: In December 2022, SpaceX unveiled Starshield, a proposed application for the internet-providing Starlink satellite constellation. Now the Pentagon has awarded SpaceX a one-year contract for Starshield that could be worth up to $70 million. The contract allows for “end-to-end service” that includes Starlink terminals, access to the Starlink constellation’s communications capabilities, ancillary equipment, and network … Continue reading "SpaceX Lands Pentagon Contract for Starshield"

item.title: SpaceX Settles Allegations of Stifling Employee's Speech - Redorbit
item.description: SpaceX has settled allegations of stifling an employee’s right to discuss workplace conditions with other SpaceX employees. The U.S. National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) filed the allegations after the employee complained. The unnamed employee had communicated with SpaceX’s human resources department about issues in the workplace. He had been told not to discuss the matter … Continue reading "SpaceX Settles Allegations of Stifling Employee’s Speech"

item.title: SpaceX Publishes Details on Direct-to-Cell Starlink Service - Redorbit
item.description: According to a new page on SpaceX’s official Starlink website, the company is planning a Starlink-based direct-to-cell service. The plans include texting service as early as 2024 and voice, data, and an “Internet of Things” application in 2025. item.title: NASA Launches Psyche Mission on SpaceX Falcon Heavy - Redorbit
item.description: NASA launched its Psyche probe from Cape Canaveral, Florida, on October 13, 2023, at 10:19 am EDT. The launch became the first launch of an interplanetary mission for SpaceX’s Falcon Heavy. The core Falcon Heavy rocket spent all its fuel to ensure that Psyche obtains the best trajectory for its 2.2-billion-mile journey. item.title: European Space Agency Signs Deal with SpaceX to Launch Galileo Satellites - Redorbit
item.description: The European Space Agency signed a deal with SpaceX to launch four navigation and communication satellites for the Galileo constellation on SpaceX’s Falcon 9 rockets. item.title: Elon Musk Says Starlink Now At "Breakeven" Cash Flow - Redorbit
item.description: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk says the Internet-providing satellite constellation Starlink has “achieved breakeven cash flow,” meaning it is now bringing in as much money as it spends.
